user.title: ADHS Track
user.description: Addresses the app uses to reach your Home Assistant. At home the internal URL is enough (IP address or .local name). For use on the go, add an external https URL (own domain/reverse proxy; Nabu Casa is not required).

kopplung.title: Pair the app
kopplung.description:
Open this link on the iPhone with ADHS Track installed (e.g. tap it in the Home Assistant app):

[Open in ADHS Track]({kopplungs_link})

Or enter it in the app under More › Home Assistant:
- Internal URL: `{url_intern}`
- External URL: `{url_extern}`
- Webhook ID: `{webhook_id}`

The webhook ID is a secret – do not share it. Then select “Submit”.

error.url_ungueltig: Please enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.extern_https: The external URL must use https (health data).
